guitar.notes: Nile Rodgers' 1960 Fender Stratocaster nicknamed 'The Hitmaker' is iconic and extremely well documented, central to Chic's funk/disco guitar sound.

tone.target: clean Nile Rodgers funk rhythm with tight compressor and slight chorus sheen
tone.profile: clean Nile Rodgers funk rhythm with tight compressor and slight chorus sheen
tone.summary: A classic funk rhythm chain utilizing a compressor for punch, followed by a clean Fender-style amp simulation (US Deluxe) and Chorus for sheen.
